column1: # Role hooks `dram apply` runs after the package converge (decisions/0008). Each is an
# existing idempotent script under system/ that takes --dry-run; apply passes --dry-run
# through on `dram apply --dry-run`. TAB-separated: role, script, mode, when, note.
#   mode auto  runs on every apply (with --yes, unasked)
#   mode ask   runs only after a yes at the terminal, never with --yes alone: it touches
#              sshd/the firewall or the boot chain, where a mistake costs remote access or
#              a boot. Order matters: rows run top to bottom.
#   when pre   runs before the package install (the [dram] repo must exist first)
# The role column takes pseudo-roles too: base (every host), metal (every host on its own
# hardware: the boot chain, the disks, the firewall), wsl (every WSL clone,
# decisions/0021), and "a,b" for a row that needs both (system/units.tsv says the same).

column5: the signed [dram] repo stanza + key (before anything installs from it); no [dram] in a WSL clone (v1)
pacman hooks, timers, pacman.conf options, limits, v4l2loopback conf
nftables default-deny, sshd keys-only, sysctl, DNS — can cut remote access
NetworkManager takes over Wi-Fi + wired from networkd + iwd (not over ssh unless --remote-ok)
the Flathub remote, the tracked apps, least-privilege overrides
the clean build chroot and /srv/dram
snapper configs, the dram-snapshot helper + pacman hooks, snapshot boot entries
a UKI for every installed kernel (cabin's linux-lts); additive, the running kernel's UKI is not touched
sbctl keys + Microsoft's, signed systemd-boot + UKIs; enrolls only in Setup Mode
LUKS2 laptops: TPM2 (PCR 7) + PIN + recovery key; after Secure Boot is on
LUKS2 laptops: the plugged-in YubiKey as a second way in beside TPM2 + PIN (one key per run)
the boot look: rEFInd (signed) in front of the UKIs, the Plymouth splash, the ly greeter in the house palette, one Hyprland session
once Windows boots from its own ESP (WIN-ESP): Arch's copy of EFI/Microsoft archived and removed, the other Windows boot entries deleted, rEFInd's tile to Windows' own entry; a no-op until then
the YubiKey after the password for sudo, polkit, login (ly, hyprlock); on only after a test touch here
cups.socket for printing (IPP Everywhere, system-config-printer); a WSL clone prints from Windows
libvirtd.socket, the main user in libvirt, DHCP/DNS from its VM network through the firewall (the VM kit stays on Arch, never in WSL)
the main user in uucp (serial ports), uaccess for USB flash programmers
/data/games owned by the main user (Steam's library goes there), ~/games
the ROM/BIOS tree on /data/emulation and ~/roms
/data/recordings owned by the main user (OBS records there), ~/videos/recordings
the recorder's firewall opening: OBS websocket + SRT from the creator hosts only
the clone's /etc/wsl.conf + hostname, Microsoft's masks, linger, rootless Podman's fixes, sshd on 127.0.0.1:2222 for VSCodium
